covers: exactly one C1 launch under the UNCHANGED frozen C1 protocol at a hard ceiling of $15.1475: the frozen fixed-path ATTENTION isolation, 2 frozen arms x 3 frozen fresh paired seeds = exactly six E1_KD_HEAVY_0860K recovery trainings; ALL SIX trainings complete before any confirmation evaluation begins; exactly one frozen confirmation evaluation per completed probe, each admitted against its own observed generation protocol before scoring; followed by the existing frozen GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE decision rule. Nothing in the protocol, the arms, the seeds, the battery, the recovery recipe, the generation protocol, the scoring contract, the statistic or the behavioural vetoes may move.

one_use.what_that_means: this authorization funds ONE launcher session. Inside it the launcher may replace a host that never became usable, up to three draws, all sharing this session's single $15.1475 ceiling. It may never have two resources billing at once: SessionRunner.release_and_confirm requires the PROVIDER to report an abandoned pod not billing before the next is created, and aborts the session if that cannot be confirmed.
one_use.consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization. Unchanged -- what the 2026-09-11 amendment withdrew is the cap on how many such sessions may exist, not the rule that each authorization funds exactly one.
one_use.after_consumption: this grant is spent. A further session needs a NEW grant, a NEW launch-bound readiness record, a NEW one-use authorization and a NEW bundle.

package.amended: 2026-09-11, withdrawing the session cap and the one-resource rule, prospectively
package.limits_do_not_transfer: the engineering allowance, the per-session ceiling, the package total and the project cap bind separately. Money now bounds how many sessions are possible; there is no separate count.
package.acquisition: up to 3 host draws in this session, one billing resource at a time, each abandoned draw released with provider confirmation and recorded with its own pod id, cost and watchdog. create_attempts stays 1: draws replace an unusable host, they do not chase stock.
package.stop_and_report: formal probe training started; whether it started cannot be confirmed; a real replay mismatch; a frozen-science conflict; unverifiable evidence provenance; or any complete valid GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE, all three of which end this round.
package._sessions_note: attempts 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14. Attempts 12 and 13 cost $0.0000 -- one create was refused by the provider, the other never reached a provider -- so they are sessions that happened and booked nothing. Attempt 14 booked $0.3999 for 22 minutes of L40S and no science.

pre_provider_refusal: a pre-provider gate refusal costs $0.00 and creates nothing, but under this package it still CONSUMES this attempt, because the launcher was invoked under an issued one-use authorization. That is the accepted cost of counting attempts at invocation rather than at provider creation.

_capacity_note: this grant does not wait on a stock LABEL. Attempt 12 was refused at a 'Low' reading, and 'Low' is not 'none' -- attempt 10 launched at 'Medium' and attempt 11 at 'Low', and neither label predicted the outcome. A null reading is UNKNOWN, not available and not permanently unavailable. What gates the launch is the live securePrice quote at or below the accepted $1.09/h and every pre-provider gate, not an inventory adjective. Repeated create calls to chase stock remain unauthorized; create_attempts stays 1. Attempts 13 and 14 add nothing to that reading: one never reached a quote, and the other acquired at $1.09/h on the first draw.
_why_this_attempt_exists: attempt 14 cleared all fourteen pre-provider gates and died at the pod CPU test gate on two tests, both of which asserted a premise only the dev box owns: battery_staged_gate's canonical out-of-tree store, and a simulator helper that fell through to a repo .venv no pod checkout has. A third divergence -- 23 tests the sweep skipped and the pod ran -- went unnamed because the pod was comparing its skip set against a pointer rather than against its own launch-bound record. All three are repaired at commit 2df2df1: the production gate is unchanged and still strict, the sweep now models host-local absence, and an unavailable skip-set comparison is now a refusal. No frozen C1 harness file was touched, so the harness digest and the execution preregistration are the ones attempt 14 ran under.
